context: Two managers prep an annual report
purpose: Teach: 原案/本業/都度/縛ら/検事/集客/文言/網羅

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本業以外の収益、原案にどう書く?
lines.en: How do we word non-core revenue in the draft?
lines.style: Clipped, efficient opening. Yuki moves through the question like a checkbox. Professional pace, no softness—she's in work mode and expects Kenji to match it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 文言は前回踏襲で、都度更新する形にします。
lines.en: We'll keep the wording from last time and refresh it each cycle.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring nod in the voice. Kenji lays it out simply—he's already thought this through. Slight warmth beneath the efficiency, signaling he's got her back.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 集客指標、四半期ごとに網羅したい。
lines.en: I want full coverage on customer-draw metrics every quarter.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. Yuki's thinking out loud but with direction. Each phrase lands with quiet intent. No hesitation—she knows what she needs.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。元検事のチェックも入れます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the ex-prosecutor review it too.
lines.style: Brisk affirmation. Kenji moves immediately to the next step—he's already anticipating what matters. Professional and seamless, like muscle memory.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 規制に縛られないよう、自由度確保で。
lines.en: Make sure we keep some breathing room—I don't want regulation tying our hands.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Yuki isn't asking, but she's not barking either. Measured pace with weight on 'breathing room.' She's drawing a line, and Kenji will understand why it matters.
